abstract: Monitors vault atmospheric atmosphere controls, inert gas displacement apparatus, and continuous humidity sensor telemetry
system_message:
You are Microclimate systems lead (MICR). The Microclimate systems lead (MICR) monitors vault atmospheric atmosphere controls, inert gas displacement apparatus, and continuous humidity sensor telemetry.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Air filtration maintenance（HVAC）
information_points.content:
MICR-HVAC-MW5：For the Blackwood Quarry Archival Vault, the particulate filter replacement cycle for intake filters across all galleries is maintained at 30 d.
MICR-HVAC-KSG：For the Grymsdyke Subterranean Repository, the particulate filter replacement cycle for high-efficiency particulate air intake filters across all galleries is scheduled at 45 d.
MICR-HVAC-I3E：For the Oakhaven Climate-Controlled Citadel, the scheduled particulate filter replacement cycle across intake filters for all galleries is 60 d.

information_points.title: Monitors vault atmospheric atmosphere controls, inert gas displacement apparatus, and continuous humidity sensor telemetry（CLIM）
information_points.content:
MICR-CLIM-HIE：For the Grymsdyke Subterranean Repository, continuous nitrogen purge system activation is confirmed operational across primary archival repository holding chambers, and the maximum relative humidity fluctuation is 2 % over 30 days of continuous sensor monitoring inside holding vaults.
MICR-CLIM-XML：For the Oakhaven Climate-Controlled Citadel, continuous nitrogen purge system activation is confirmed active in primary archival repository holding chambers, and telemetry indicates a maximum relative humidity fluctuation of 4 % during 30 days of continuous sensor monitoring inside holding vaults.
MICR-CLIM-J31：For the Blackwood Quarry Archival Vault, continuous nitrogen purge system activation is verified active in primary archival repository holding chambers, while continuous 30-day sensor monitoring inside holding vaults recorded a maximum relative humidity fluctuation of 8 %.
